node.statement: Directly expanding (1.1)-(1.2) of def-routef-raw-factor-setting and using lem-routef-raw-factor-setting-formation: C_theta=12*(sqrt(2)-1)>0, C_A=20+(211/8)*C_theta>0, bar_C_E=max{1,C_E}>=1, hence C_V=bar_C_E*C_A>0 and C_T=C_theta+3*C_V>0, all finite; eta_A, epsilon_E, rho_theta, and rho_AI are positive, so every entry of rho_T is positive. Substitution into (1.2) then proves, in displayed order, the asserted coefficient finiteness/positivity and radius positivity, because each operation is a finite sum, positive multiple, reciprocal of a positive scalar, or finite minimum of positive scalars. Global-header independence is preserved under these scalar operations.
